source_findings: The Cron library delegates session-only storage/list/delete to imported Fxe/Om/TX. Their exact ownership and quota/reset mutators remain unresolved.
Tool descriptions describe recurring:false as one-shot and durable:false as session-only. Genuine discovery schemas were not exercised.
One-shot times at selected minute boundaries may shift up to90seconds early, clamped at creation. Nominal cron expressions cannot establish a future-through-observation obligation.
REPL-idle scheduling is described, but print-mode scheduler lifetime and quota retention are not established.
consequence: A pre-quota CronList and an empty post-quota background snapshot cannot prove survival or completion. Unproven scheduled work remains unknown/incomplete and cannot authorize automatic recovery, stop or successor creation.
decision: Do not build the larger proposed native Cron fixture while its decisive survival witness remains unavailable. Preserve the proof gap.
limits: No CronCreate/List/Delete, due wakeup, post-quota schedule witness or complete workflow census was observed.
This source-only result does not invalidate the separate R9 bounded working-interval PASS or promote it into global completeness.
